correctness.rationale: Direct block-matrix calculation yields hub radial quotient [2(n-1)-(n-3)t]/(n+1) and rim Fourier quotients t+2(t-1)cos(2πk/n). The rim minimum is 2c-(2c-1)t and always no greater than radial for t>=1, by cos(π/n)>(n-1)/(n+1). This proves the exact spectral gap and cutoff with multiplicity one/even or two/odd. Schoenberg centered Gram has rank n minus that nullity at cutoff. The embedded check_wheel.py completed 10,009 finite checks; universality rests on the explicit spectral proof.

value.rationale: A canonical natural graph-metric family receives a complete exact p-negative-type classification. The spectral gap is a quantitative finite-metric stability invariant for every p, while odd/even critical nullities give distinct sharp Euclidean snowflake ranks. The infinite odd-rim exponent asymptotics identify an explicit decay scale to the even-rim obstruction. This is a motivated classification rather than an arbitrary finite subcase; it does not claim the underlying Fourier transform or generic matrix test as new.
